exposure: Region of residence (Cairo metropolitan region, Nile Delta region (North), and Upper Egypt (South))
cohort: 299 children with ALL and 351 healthy controls in Egypt
finding: The risk of childhood ALL in Egypt appears to be associated with older maternal age, maternal use of ovulation induction medication, and Cesarean section delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with an increased risk of ALL in Egyptian children.
